query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

content.text:
Arrr, me hearties!

The tide be turnin’, the wind be at our backs, and somewhere beyond that misty horizon lies a treasure so grand it’ll make kings weep and legends tremble!

But gold don’t leap into the hands of cowards. It waits for the bold, the clever, and the stubborn souls who’ll dig through sand, storm, and curse to claim it!

So hoist the sails, sharpen yer wits, and keep yer eyes keen! Every map mark, every strange stone, every whisper of the sea may lead us closer.

Sail with courage, dig with fury, and by dawn or doom, we’ll carve our names into history!

Now move, ye scallywags — treasure waits for no crew!
